name: Lookup Table Addressing for Resampling
definition: A method to avoid if-else branches and costly ComputeOffset calls for resampling by using a precomputed lookup table of offsets. It maps the sample position within a brick to one of 8 cases based on which neighboring bricks contain the 7 required adjacent samples.
summary: Lookup Table Addressing for Resampling computes memory offsets for brick-structured volumes using a precomputed table, replacing costly conditional branches with direct lookups to improve performance.
